description: Manifest of load-bearing constants, each tied to a primary source archived in build/. Every entry with verify:true carries a machine-checkable extraction spec; tests/verify_sources.py re-extracts the value from the archived source and asserts it equals the value here, then asserts the value matches where the constant lives in code. This layer exists to kill the internally-consistent-but-wrong failure class: a wrong SEEK base ($4,636) once passed 741 consistency checks because nothing compared constants to primary sources.

entries.name: seek_base_fy2027
entries.units: USD per student in average daily attendance
entries.locator: page 20, SEEK base guarantee sentence (2026 Ky. Acts ch. 168, HB 500)

extraction.regex: base guarantee of \$([\d,]+) per student in average daily attendance in fiscal year 2026-2027

entries.note: The enacted FY2027 base. A prior release shipped $4,636 and passed every internal check; this entry is the guard against that class of error. The constants are consolidated in build/nmes_constants.py; each model script must either import SEEK_BASE from it or carry a literal assignment equal to this value, and if a build/constants.py appears later the verifier checks its SEEK assignment too.

entries.name: seek_base_fy2028
entries.units: USD per student in average daily attendance
entries.locator: page 20, same sentence as seek_base_fy2027

extraction.regex: in fiscal year 2026-2027 and \$([\d,]+) per student in average daily attendance in fiscal year 2027-\s*2028

entries.name: seek_base_fy2026
entries.units: USD per student in average daily attendance
entries.locator: page 25, SEEK base guarantee sentence (2024 Ky. Acts ch. 175, HB 6)

extraction.regex: and \$([\d,]+) per student in average\s+daily\s+attendance in fiscal\s+year\s*2025-\s*2026

entries.note: Enacted 2024-2026 biennial budget, archived copy; FY2025 base $4,326 appears in the same sentence.

entries.name: teacher_loaded_cost
entries.units: USD per teacher per year, district fully loaded rookie cost (half of the two-teacher pair)
entries.locator: district Response, Appendix A.1, certified staffing line (image capture)
entries.note: The only archived source is an image (the district's response PDF, build/response_to_the_10_questions.pdf, is a scan with no text layer, and the appendix is archived as a PNG). No OCR in this pipeline, so the source side cannot be machine-extracted; the code side is still asserted: nmes_constants.py prices TEACH as 108_958.80 / 2.

entries.name: teacher_loaded_cost_pair
entries.units: USD per year for the two-teacher pair as printed by the district
entries.locator: district Response, Appendix A.1, the $108,958.80 line (image capture)
entries.note: Same image-only source as teacher_loaded_cost. The verifier asserts the pair is exactly twice the single-teacher figure and matches the numerator of the TEACH assignment in nmes_constants.py.
